sources.quote: How to Web Conference | October 5-7, 2027 - How to Web Conference Hey Builders, we're back! Venture Report 2025 Partner with us Buy Tickets Bucharest · Oct 5–7, 2027 Eastern Europe's leading startup & technology conference. Three days in Bucharest for tech professionals and leaders, founders, investors, and anyone who wants a sharper read on the year ahead. Buy 2027 Tickets Partner with us 3,000+ Attendees 9,000+ Meetings 500+ Founders 250+ Investors 100+ Speakers 50+ Side events 2026 In Review To every speaker, founder, investor and attendee who brought their clarity and drive to Bucharest for the 2026 edition – thank you for making How to Web Conference unforgettable. As we begin building the 2027 experience, we let it be guided by a reflection shared on stage by Nicoleta-Ramona Dinu (State Adviser for Economic and Social Policies, Presidential Administration of Romania): “Romania must become a place where startups scale into global companies, drive innovation and build cutting-edge technology. A resilient ecosystem requires time, trust and true collaboration across industries, generations and the public sector. The future belongs to those willing to build it.”
